# Richverse Ecotech

> A technology and energy studio for teams commissioning websites, campaigns, security reviews, or energy plans. Offices in Austin (United States) and Accra (Ghana); accepting project enquiries worldwide.

## Services
- [Web Development](https://richverseecotech.com/services/web-development): Websites, storefronts, and business applications with a journey map, acceptance checks, and handover.
- [Digital Marketing](https://richverseecotech.com/services/digital-marketing): Channel planning, content, landing pages, and reporting on qualified enquiries.
- [Cybersecurity](https://richverseecotech.com/services/cybersecurity): Defensive reviews of business risks and access controls, remediation ownership, and closure evidence.
- [Renewable Energy](https://richverseecotech.com/services/renewable-energy): Load profiles, solar and storage comparisons, and site checks for business continuity.

## Company
- [About](https://richverseecotech.com/about): Leadership, office contact details, and how we work.
- [Contact](https://richverseecotech.com/contact): Start a project or partnership. Email: richverseecotech@gmail.com

## Studio work
- [Service-to-enquiry redesign](https://richverseecotech.com/work/richverse-studio-website): An in-house project with a working example.

## Worked examples
- [Qualified enquiry rate](https://richverseecotech.com/services/digital-marketing#worked-example): Illustrative campaign report. Eight matched qualified enquiries from 200 eligible sessions is 4%; two unmatched enquiries are reported separately.
- [Access review closure](https://richverseecotech.com/services/cybersecurity#worked-example): Illustrative review record showing the owner, change and independent check.
- [Essential load worksheet](https://richverseecotech.com/services/renewable-energy#worked-example): Illustrative four-hour outage. The 400 Wh total is energy delivered to the devices, not a battery recommendation.

## Insights
- [Website redesign brief and template](https://richverseecotech.com/blog/website-redesign-brief): Scope a customer task, constraints and acceptance checks before comparing development quotes. Includes an editable brief.
- [Repair, migrate, or rebuild?](https://richverseecotech.com/blog/repair-migrate-or-rebuild): How to scope changes to an existing website.
- [Estimate office backup energy](https://richverseecotech.com/blog/estimate-office-backup-energy): Calculate watt-hours and see how a shorter lighting schedule changes the result.
- [Studio guides](https://richverseecotech.com/blog): Practical reading on websites, campaign measurement, business security, and energy planning.
